children.text: Explain: why crawler-v3 costs more per profile than the old crawler that did about 70M profiles (owner asked 07:5xZ), with old vs new cost and ranked cuts
children.note: Page: http://localhost:5176/page/sessions/2026/10/12/1648-crawler-v3-cost-per-profile/cost-per-profile.html. The HTTP read is the same as v2, about 36-45 KB. The 70M was v2's table with about 30M stubs, and the fast run was a profile-only drain. v3 adds about 6.2 history jobs per new read, about 1.2 MB each, and history was 93.6% of census proxy, about 1.46 TB of the '2TB'. Top cuts: cap history, ship profile-photo-only media, and drop the 750 KB HTML fallback.
